approximation_stated: His edge is read from tick order flow (footprint, delta, big-trade prints) on NQ futures. Not available here for S1. Proxies: previous-day value area from 15m bars (mid price (open+close)/2 x quote volume, 24 equal bins, 70% value area), aggression = 15m quote volume > 2 x mean of the previous 20 bars, delta sign = taker-buy share of the bar (tbq/qv). Market = 15 liquid Binance USDT-M alts, not NQ. A failure therefore says 'this volume-profile approximation does not work on crypto alts', not that his discretionary method fails.

profile: for UTC day D use the 96 bars of day D-1: price = (open+close)/2, weight = quote volume; 24 equal bins between min and max price; POC = bin with most volume (lowest bin on ties); value area grows from the POC adding the neighbouring bin with more volume (upper on ties) until >= 70% of the day's volume; VAH = upper edge of the highest VA bin, VAL = lower edge of the lowest. Skip day if < 90 valid bars on D-1.

trials.VP1_NY_IMBALANCE: decision bars that start 13:30..16:15 UTC (bar 54..65 of day D). Long: close > VAH, qv > 2 x mean qv of the previous 20 bars, tbq/qv > 0.55. Short: close < VAL, same volume rule, tbq/qv < 0.45. First trigger per coin per day only. Enter at the next bar's open. Exit at the next bar's open after the first bar that (a) closes back inside the value area (long: close <= VAH; short: close >= VAL) = stop, or (b) closes at or beyond VAH + (VAH - VAL) (short: VAL - (VAH - VAL)) = target; otherwise at the open of the 20:00 UTC bar (bar 80).
trials.VP2_LONDON_REVERSION: decision bars that start 07:00..09:45 UTC (bar 28..39 of day D). Short: some earlier bar of day D closed > VAH and this bar closes inside [VAL, VAH] with tbq/qv < 0.5. Long: some earlier bar of day D closed < VAL, this bar closes inside [VAL, VAH] with tbq/qv > 0.5. First trigger per coin per day only. Enter at the next bar's open. Exit at the next bar's open after the first bar that (a) reaches the POC mid price by close (short: close <= POC; long: close >= POC) = target, or (b) closes outside the value area again on the entry side (short: close > VAH; long: close < VAL) = stop; otherwise at the open of the 12:00 UTC bar (bar 48).
